Source [S2] explicitly states it adapts mip-NeRF 360 parameterization for unbounded 360 scenes, mapping them to a bounded unit sphere volume (or cuboid) for voxel grid allocation. Source [S3] confirms that scene contraction is used to map unbounded space into a finite grid (bounded data structure) for occupancy grids. All specific details in the claim are present in the provided evidence.
